openQuestions: Syllabus titles were written from the UPSC Anthropology syllabus as known, not pasted from the notification; please check wording and numbering against the current CSE notification.
Hindi subject name: नृविज्ञान used (UPSC Hindi papers); मानवविज्ञान is also common, and is kept for the Anthropological Survey of India's Hindi name (भारतीय मानवविज्ञान सर्वेक्षण).
Node split is an editorial choice: Paper 1 has 64 nodes and Paper 2 has 34. Section 1.3 (four branches) is one node and 1.4 is split into three; the owner may prefer different splits.
Paper 2 keeps UPSC's wording 'PTGs (Primitive Tribal Groups)'; the government term is now PVTGs. Should titles keep UPSC wording or the current term?
Fossil dates (Laetoli about 3.6 mya, Lucy about 3.2 mya, Oldowan about 2.6 mya, Acheulian about 1.7 mya, Attirampakkam about 1.5 mya) are rounded textbook figures; all are in factsToCheck.
Evolution terms in Hindi: प्राकृतिक चयन used; NCERT Hindi biology also uses प्राकृतिक वरण. The node schema has no hiAlt, so this is noted in factsToCheck only.
